name: pi-extensions-workspace
description: Dev-only workspace for pi extensions: shared TypeScript toolchain. Not a pi package itself.

scripts.test:tool-output: npm run sync-types && node --no-warnings --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/pi-test-loader.mjs --test pi-tool-output/*.test.mjs && node pi-tool-output/integration.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:tool-output && npm run test:pricing && npm run test:recap && npm run test:tree-pane
